title: Veo 3.1 Fast switches to Google's GA model ID
summary:
Veo 3.1 Fast moved off a retired model ID, a generative runner joined the catalog, and account and model-health views got tidier.

Video generation requests now use `veo-3.1-fast-generate-001` instead of the retired preview alias, addressing model-not-found errors.

Neon Runner, a retro-anime infinite runner whose environment changes with player performance, joined the games catalog. Another build-category submission was added without a usable name or link; the README also now credits recent app contributors by GitHub profile.

Expired API keys no longer appear in the dashboard, while keys without an expiry remain visible. Enter and /hello also stopped presenting the legacy Nectar tier as one users can pursue; existing backend tier definitions are unchanged.
